name: INDEXX
tagline: Rebuilds your Instagram saves into a searchable library on your Mac
description: Takes the posts you saved on Instagram and turns them into a private, searchable archive kept on your own computer. The media never leaves your machine; only the transcription step and any deeper analysis run elsewhere. The result is fast lookup over everything you have filed away.
author: kevinrose
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
